description_en: Queries the IP address list of a domain name by calling DescribeDcdnUserVipsByDomain
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-user-vips-by-domain --domain-name example.com --available on --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnUserVipsByDomain

parameters.help_en: The domain name. Only a single domain name is supported
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query healthy VIPs. Valid values:

on: healthy VIPs.

off: all VIPs
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询健康VIP。取值：

on：健康VIP。

off：全部VIP
parameters.name: available
